div.div: Sovereign by design: the control plane never connects into a landscape. Every arrow across a landscape boundary starts at the bridge or the courier. One credential per landscape: the bridge identity (TOFU-pinned or customer CA). Git credentials never leave the control plane; registry credentials never leave the landscape.
